title: The Vampire Squid That Never Hunts and Glows for 10 Minutes

scenes.text: The vampire squid is a squid that never hunts.
It lives about 600 to 900 metres down, where there is almost no oxygen.
It eats marine snow, the falling remains and droppings of dead sea creatures.
It is the only known cephalopod that eats nothing alive.
Its eyes are the biggest for body size of any animal. And when annoyed, it releases glowing mucus that shines for almost ten minutes.
Its name means vampire squid from hell. It eats leftovers.

description:
The vampire squid lives in the deep sea and, unlike every other known cephalopod, it does not catch live prey.
It drifts in oxygen-poor water 600 to 900 metres down and eats marine snow. Its eyes are the largest relative to body size of any animal, and its glowing mucus can shine for nearly ten minutes.
Would you eat leftovers for a living? Comment below.
first_comment: Its Latin name, Vampyroteuthis infernalis, literally means the vampire squid from hell, yet it is about 28 centimetres of drifting leftovers-eater. Which deep-sea animal should we cover next?
